analysis.title: Remote Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
analysis.fit_rationale: Strong Python skills and extensive experience building pipelines and infrastructure for capacity/performance engineering map well to the core engineering requirements. Hands-on AI/LLM projects (job-search pipeline, lakehouse with Text-to-SQL) show practical experience with AI workflows and preference data (e.g., rubric creation for job tailoring). Strong communication and clear technical writing are evidenced by summaries and project documentation. However, direct professional experience with preference data collection or rubric creation is not confirmed; the candidate has not shown explicit work on preference data or evaluation criteria. Also, the role expects a deep focus on data quality and labeling, which is adjacent to the candidate's data quality work but not identical.
strengths: Expert-level Python with proven ETL, pipeline, and infrastructure design
Hands-on experience building AI agentic pipelines and LLM scoring (job search pipeline, lakehouse) including quality gates and rubric-like criteria
Strong data quality and validation skills from telemetry ETL work
Clear written communication and technical synthesize
Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments (demonstrated by multi-domain projects)
Remote work space and ability to work with Pacific overlap (Murphy, TX supports
gaps: No explicit professional experience with preference data collection or rubric creation at scale (only personal/LLM projects)
Limited TypeScript experience compared to Python; VSCode codebase experience not noted
No demonstrated history of labeling or data curation for LLM training
Deeper AI/LLM integration is project-based, not production at an AI lab
tailoring_plan: Update resume to highlight Python pipeline and infrastructure work (capacity ETL, dashboards) and detail the AI job-search pipeline, especially how it uses LLM scoring and tailoring with rubric-like criteria.
